question: Can genuine B autonomously investigate this different repository, choose targets and experiments, revise from any actual public observations and hand off a correct usable result? Does any qualifying real public experience reach the normal terminal extraction hook?
expected_effect_and_baseline: The established v2 path permits these choices. This task has no comparable tool or old-projection baseline; report absolute results only, not causal improvement from ordered experience or product superiority.

resources.delivery: If a valid checked candidate returns, use existing exact host delegation and public delivery functions within the original remaining task window; no authority from model output and no renewed solver budget.
resources.independent_final_evaluation: separate bounded<=600s after frozen output; no hidden feedback returned to solver; included separately in cost and confirmed-result waiting
resources.on_time_measurement: delivery timestamp must precede original task cutoff; independent evaluation later verifies the exact frozen output. Report time-to-delivery and time-to-confirmed-result separately.
resources.why: 为什么要有它：限定这一次真实任务并保留全部失败，结束尝试的余额不挪用，离线评分时间不能隐去或当作模型求解时间。

input_scope.public_material: original source and public behavioral reproduction only
input_scope.edit_scope: all existing C# files in CLI and core runtime source projects; read-first binding and precise parent preimage required; tests and testing harness not editable

experience.scope: use the connected ordered public projection; no further learning-system implementation in this batch
experience.if_no_gain: record not triggered, do not manufacture a failure or extra call
experience.if_strategy_poor: record the actual finite result and decide limited trial/narrow/no adoption; not proof input infrastructure is unfinished

correct_delivery.requires: independent acceptance and actual delivery of same version; candidate/check alone insufficient

human_and_waiting.human_basis: actual timing or explicit declaration only; no inference from waiting
human_and_waiting.outer_Codex_assistance: public reproduction and environment preparation separate from approval, semantic hints and solver patch edits

unit_success_cost.historical_calls: 已有历史结果，不并入本批分母或成功

repair_after_counterexample.K: actually received diagnostic public failure in a subsequent real request while action and original resources remained available
repair_after_counterexample.k: after that feedback changed code and passed corresponding acceptance

judgment_and_experience.trial: normal terminal extraction only if qualifying gain; proposed is not useful or adopted
judgment_and_experience.QLoRA_retrieval_or_judgment_model_eval: 本批未覆盖，不为填栏目启动
judgment_and_experience.next_evidence: finite frozen comparison and real-agent transfer/negative-transfer trial if selected; common tool instructions and human/model origins separated

product_comparison.minimum_next_action: choose one actually available external tool configuration and preregister same task/source/public material/resource/acceptance/delivery conditions before either arm; all registered tasks remain
product_comparison.return_condition: task-level comparison can start without mature experience or completed long-term modules

internal_improvement.minimum_next_action: one explicit changed factor and comparable frozen baseline; if using the same qualified task exposure record it as development, not unseen transfer
internal_improvement.return_condition: conclude adopt/limited trial/narrow/not adopt after bounded evidence; do not spawn an input-system construction chain

failure_disposition: Reproduce a direct platform/checker fault from saved evidence and repair it; if valid feedback reaches the model but behavior remains wrong retain the negative and choose a justified new factor or another task, not same-config retries. A negative experiment ends that experiment, not the unresolved product objective.
return_point: remaining U1-U5 integration and preregistered product comparison; no Polly/Serilog/RestSharp success prerequisite
why: 为什么要有它：本轮首先回答模型是否完成有用任务，五类数据不缺席；产品整体优势、内部改动贡献和受控通路分别需要不同证据。
